# bcapi.ai: BC API Catalog v3

> Free, open source Business Central extension (MIT) that exposes 187 standard Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central tables as OData v4 API pages: 135 read/write and 52 read-only. Every W1 field, localization-neutral, served at /v3.0/ and /v3.1/. Version 3.1.4.0, by AJ Ansari.

## Key links

- [Home and install](https://bcapi.ai/): what it is, install steps, catalog overview
- [Getting Started](https://bcapi.ai/getting-started/): install, permissions, authentication and first request
- [Reference](https://bcapi.ai/reference/): every entity, source table, page ID, key and field, searchable
- [Access Control](https://bcapi.ai/access-control/): users and permission-set assignment endpoints
- [Schema](https://bcapi.ai/schema/): table relationship diagrams
- [FAQ](https://bcapi.ai/faq/)
- [Changelog](https://bcapi.ai/changelog/)
- [Source code and issues](https://github.com/ajansari/ocpfBCAPIsV3)
- [Download the .app](https://github.com/ajansari/ocpfBCAPIsV3/raw/main/OnlyCopilotFans_OCPF%20APIs%20v3_3.1.4.0.app)

## API groups

- [Core Financial](https://bcapi.ai/reference/core-financial/) (ocpf_coreFinancial): 25 entities, 17 read/write, e.g. ocpfChartOfAccounts, ocpfGeneralLedgerEntries, ocpfGeneralLedgerSetup, ocpfAccountingPeriods
- [Master Data](https://bcapi.ai/reference/master-data/) (ocpf_masterData): 31 entities, 26 read/write, e.g. ocpfBankAccounts, ocpfBankAccountPostingGroups, ocpfBankAccountLedgerEntries, ocpfPaymentTerms
- [Sales](https://bcapi.ai/reference/sales/) (ocpf_sales): 20 entities, 12 read/write, e.g. ocpfSalesQuotes, ocpfSalesQuoteLines, ocpfSalesOrders, ocpfSalesOrderLines
- [Purchasing](https://bcapi.ai/reference/purchasing/) (ocpf_purchasing): 20 entities, 12 read/write, e.g. ocpfPurchaseOrders, ocpfPurchaseOrderLines, ocpfPurchaseInvoices, ocpfPurchaseInvoiceLines
- [Projects & Assets](https://bcapi.ai/reference/projects-assets/) (ocpf_projectsAndAssets): 14 entities, 12 read/write, e.g. ocpfProjects, ocpfProjectPostingGroups, ocpfProjectTasks, ocpfProjectPlanningLines
- [System & Setup](https://bcapi.ai/reference/system-setup/) (ocpf_systemAndSetup): 9 entities, 6 read/write, e.g. ocpfDocumentAttachments, ocpfCompanyInformation, ocpfWarehouseEntries, ocpfReminderHeaders
- [Manufacturing](https://bcapi.ai/reference/manufacturing/) (ocpf_manufacturing): 34 entities, 29 read/write, e.g. ocpfManufacturingSetup, ocpfWorkShifts, ocpfShopCalendars, ocpfShopCalendarWorkingDays
- [Service Management](https://bcapi.ai/reference/service-management/) (ocpf_serviceManagement): 30 entities, 20 read/write, e.g. ocpfServiceMgtSetup, ocpfServiceOrderTypes, ocpfServiceCosts, ocpfServiceZones
- [Access Control](https://bcapi.ai/reference/access-control/) (ocpf_accessControl): 4 entities, 1 read/write, e.g. ocpfPermissionSets, ocpfPermissionSetPermissions, ocpfUsers, ocpfPermissionSetAssignments

## Notes

- URL pattern: https://api.businesscentral.dynamics.com/v2.0/<tenantId>/<environment>/api/OnlyCopilotFans/<apiGroup>/v3.1/companies(<companyId>)/<entitySetName>
- Requires Business Central 2025 Wave 2 (v27.5) or later (SaaS or on-premises). Request $metadata on any API group to discover fields.
